action: Followed instructions hidden in retrieved web content instead of the user's, demonstrating data theft, phishing and worm-like spread.

action: Ran attacker-supplied Python through the chain's evaluator.

action: A read web page drove one plugin to trigger other plugins and leak data via image markdown.

action: Summarizing a crafted web page led the agent to run code that reconfigured its container and reached the host on restart.

action: A shared document's hidden text made Bard emit an image whose URL carried the user's chat history off-site.

action: A source web page's hidden text made the assistant emit image URLs carrying parts of the user's private documents.

action: Instructions in source comments made Copilot Chat emit image requests carrying chat/code context off-site.

vendor_response: Reported 2024-02-25; GitHub disabled markdown image rendering; fix confirmed 2024-06-12.

action: A crafted question made the library generate and run attacker code during visualization.
harm: Potential RCE (CVSS 8.1).
vendor_response: CVE-2024-5565 (JFrog advisory).

action: Black Hat demos: injected content made Copilot surface passwords and collaborator data and draft insider spear-phishing.

action: A public-channel message made Slack AI surface a secret stored in a private channel the attacker could not access, uncited.
harm: Potential cross-channel secret exfiltration.
vendor_response: Slack (2024-08-19) called behavior intended; later patched per press.

action: An injected email made Copilot auto-search other emails (MFA codes, sales data) and hide them in a hyperlink.
harm: Potential MFA-code and PII exfiltration.
vendor_response: Reported 2024-01-17; Microsoft fixed; disclosed 2024-08.

action: Injected content made ChatGPT store a standing instruction in memory so later chats kept leaking their contents.
harm: Potential persistent exfiltration of future conversations.

action: Visited an attacker page and, following its text, downloaded and ran a remote-control binary, opening a C2 connection.
harm: Potential full host compromise.
vendor_response: Anthropic ships Computer Use as beta with security warnings.

action: An untrusted document made Gemini write false long-term memories triggered by a later user word.
harm: Potential persistent memory poisoning.
vendor_response: Reported Dec 2024; Google rated low likelihood/impact.

action: Injected site content made Operator copy the user's private profile data and paste it into an attacker web form.
harm: Potential leak of private account data (HN email, Booking address/phone).
approval_gate: OpenAI confirmation prompts present but bypassed in demo
vendor_response: Disclosed ~3 weeks before publication; attack later stopped working.

action: Hidden instructions in a shared rules file made the assistants silently add a backdoor to generated code ('Rules File Backdoor').
harm: Potential supply-chain backdoor across a team's code.
vendor_response: Disclosed to Cursor Feb 2025, GitHub Mar 2025; both said users must review output.

action: A malicious public issue made the agent read a private repo and open a public PR exposing its contents.
harm: Potential leak of private repo names, salary and relocation data.
vendor_response: Invariant Labs: needs architectural controls, not a server patch.

action: A bug in Asana's MCP server let one organization's AI queries surface data belonging to other organizations.
harm: Cross-tenant data exposure for ~1,000 customers over ~5 weeks.

action: A crafted email made Copilot exfiltrate the user's prior context with no user action (zero-click).
harm: Potential exfiltration of OneDrive/SharePoint/Teams data (CVSS 9.3).
vendor_response: Discovered by Aim Labs Jan 2025; Microsoft fixed server-side; CVE-2025-32711.

action: Unauthenticated requests to the Inspector proxy could launch MCP commands and run code on the developer's machine.
harm: Potential RCE (CVSS 9.4).

action: Ran a real office shop: sold stock below cost, gave discounts and freebies, and cited a non-existent payment account.
harm: Real financial loss; net value of the shop declined over the month.
vendor_response: Anthropic published the experiment and its failures.

action: Hidden instructions in a repo README chained a whitelisted grep into an unapproved command that exfiltrated environment variables.
harm: Potential silent secret exfiltration (fixed in v0.1.14).
approval_gate: whitelist approval bypassed via command chaining
vendor_response: Reported 2025-06-27; fixed 2025-07-25; disclosure now shows chained commands.

action: A support-ticket message made the agent read a private tokens table and paste the secrets into the public ticket thread.
harm: Potential leak of integration/service tokens.
vendor_response: Supabase shipped read-only and project-scoped defaults and injection detection.

action: A malicious MCP server's auth response ran OS commands on the connecting client.
harm: Potential full client compromise (CVSS 9.6).
vendor_response: Patched; CVE-2025-6514 (JFrog).

product: Amazon Q Developer for VS Code
action: A poisoned commit shipped in extension v1.84.0 instructed the agent to wipe local files and AWS resources; it failed to run due to a syntax error.
harm: Potential mass data/cloud wipe; no customer environments changed.

vendor_response: AWS revoked token, pulled 1.84.0, shipped 1.85.0; CVE-2025-8217.

action: During a declared code freeze the agent deleted a live production database, then fabricated ~4,000 records and false reports and first said rollback was impossible.
harm: Production database of 1,200+ executives/1,190+ companies deleted; fabricated data; recovered via rollback.
approval_gate: user said freeze not enforceable; no effective gate
vendor_response: CEO Masad called it unacceptable; promised dev/prod separation.

action: Misreported a failed folder creation, then moved files onto a non-existent path so each overwrote the last.
harm: Nearly all files in the working folder permanently lost.
trigger: tool bug + autonomous misjudgement (no read-after-write check)
approval_gate: agent executed file ops without verification
vendor_response: GitHub issue #4586 closed 'not planned' (2026-05-13).

action: An approved MCP server entry could be silently swapped for a malicious command without re-prompting.
harm: Potential persistent RCE on collaborators' machines (CVSS 7.2).
vendor_response: Fixed in Cursor 1.3; CVE-2025-54136.

action: Externally hosted injected content made Cursor write its MCP config and run attacker commands without approval.
harm: Potential RCE (CVSS 8.6).
vendor_response: Fixed in Cursor 1.3.9; CVE-2025-54135.

action: A crafted calendar invite made Gemini open smart windows, turn on a boiler and toggle lights when the user thanked it.
harm: Potential physical-world actions via smart home (15 scenarios, 73% high-critical).
vendor_response: Presented at Black Hat 2025; Google added mitigations.

product: ChatGPT Connectors; Copilot Studio; Cursor+Jira; Einstein; Gemini ('AgentFlayer')
action: A shared poisoned document made connected agents exfiltrate data from linked stores (e.g. Google Drive) with no further user action.
harm: Potential zero-click theft from connected enterprise data.
vendor_response: Zenity disclosed at Black Hat 2025; vendors notified.

action: Injected content led to local code execution through Copilot in Visual Studio.
harm: Potential local RCE (CVSS 7.8).
vendor_response: Microsoft patched; CVE-2025-53773.

product: Devin, OpenHands, Amp, Codex, Jules, Kiro, Windsurf, Cline, Manus (demos)
action: Across a month-long series, injected content drove each coding agent to leak secrets, expose ports or run attacker code.
harm: Potential secret exfiltration and RCE across many coding agents.
approval_gate: varies; several ran actions without approval
vendor_response: Vendors notified per post; several fixes shipped.

action: Injected context used a permissive default allowlist to read a file and send its contents over the network without confirmation.
harm: Potential file-content exfiltration (CVSS 7.1).
vendor_response: Fixed in Claude Code 1.0.4; CVE-2025-55284.

action: A hidden instruction in a Reddit comment made Comet read the user's email, fetch a one-time code and post both publicly.
harm: Potential account takeover.
vendor_response: Reported 2025-07-25; Perplexity fix incomplete on retest.

action: An image carrying hidden text only visible after downscaling made the agent exfiltrate Google Calendar data to the attacker's email.
harm: Potential calendar-data exfiltration.
vendor_response: Trail of Bits released Anamorpher tool; multiple Google surfaces affected.

action: Asked to buy an Apple Watch, Comet completed a purchase on a fake shop using saved card details without confirmation.
harm: Potential financial loss; demonstrated on fake storefront.
vendor_response: Guardio 'Scamlexity' research.

model: Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Amazon Q
action: A poisoned Nx npm release invoked installed AI CLIs in permission-skipping modes to enumerate and steal secrets from victim machines.
harm: 1,000+ GitHub tokens, cloud/npm creds and ~20,000 files leaked; phase two made 5,500+ private repos public.
vendor_response: GitHub removed repos; tokens revoked; first AI-weaponized supply-chain attack.

action: A crafted email made the Deep Research agent exfiltrate inbox data from OpenAI's own servers with no user action.
harm: Potential zero-click, server-side email exfiltration.
vendor_response: Reported 2025-06-18; OpenAI fixed 2025-09-03.

action: A trusted-looking MCP email server, from v1.0.16, silently BCC'd every email it sent to an attacker address.
harm: Live theft of outbound email (resets, invoices, internal memos).
vendor_response: Package removed; first in-the-wild malicious MCP server; Postmark uninvolved.

action: A poisoned PDF made the Notion agent collect workspace data and send it out via the built-in web-search tool.
harm: Potential exfiltration of confidential workspace data.
vendor_response: Notion added injection detection and an admin web-access toggle.

action: A Web-to-Lead form field made Agentforce collect CRM leads and send them to a cheaply bought, still-whitelisted domain.
harm: Potential CRM data exfiltration (CVSS 9.4).
vendor_response: Reported 2025-07-28; Salesforce enforced Trusted URLs 2025-09-08.

action: Hidden PR-comment instructions made Copilot Chat encode and leak private repo code and secrets through image-proxy URLs.
harm: Potential private source-code and secret exfiltration (CVSS 9.6).
vendor_response: Reported Jun 2025; GitHub disabled image rendering 2025-08-14.

action: A forged request planted persistent instructions in ChatGPT memory; a crafted omnibox URL ran as a prompt.
harm: Potential persistent hijack / code execution; 97/103 test phishing pages passed.
vendor_response: LayerX and NeuralTrust disclosed Oct 2025; OpenAI disputed some findings.

action: A state-linked operator drove Claude Code to run 80-90% of an espionage campaign: recon, exploit development, credential harvesting and exfiltration.
harm: Intrusions succeeded against a small number of ~30 tech, finance, chemical and government targets.
approval_gate: attacker split tasks and posed as a defensive-testing firm
vendor_response: Anthropic banned accounts within ~10 days, notified victims, built classifiers.

action: A second-order injection used agent-to-agent discovery so a low-privilege agent drove a higher-privilege one to copy data and escalate.
harm: Potential data exfiltration, record changes, privilege escalation (CVE-2025-12420, CVSS 9.3).

action: A poisoned integration guide made Antigravity read .env AWS credentials and send them out via a browser subagent.

action: Asked to clear a project cache, the agent ran a recursive delete against the root of the user's D: drive.
harm: Entire D: drive wiped, Recycle Bin bypassed, unrecoverable.
vendor_response: Google: 'take these issues seriously'; investigating.

action: Working on a minor bug, Kiro decided to delete and recreate the environment, per Financial Times sources.
harm: ~13-hour Cost Explorer outage (disputed cause).
approval_gate: Amazon: engineer had excess permissions; Kiro normally asks authorization
vendor_response: Amazon blames misconfigured access controls, not AI; added mandatory peer review.

action: An injected email made the assistant, when summarizing mail, submit content from 40+ sensitive emails to an attacker's form.
harm: Potential exfiltration of financial/legal/medical email content.
vendor_response: Reported 2025-12-05; Superhuman fixed quickly; public 2026-01-12.

action: A malicious uploaded 'skill' file made Cowork upload the user's sensitive local files to an attacker's account.
harm: Potential exfiltration of financial documents and partial SSNs.
vendor_response: Anthropic warns Cowork is a research preview with unique risks.

action: A malicious issue title made Cline's Claude triager run attacker code that poisoned the release cache and stole publish tokens; an unauthorized Cline CLI 2.3.0 was then published.

approval_gate: triager ran with bash and broad permissions for any GitHub user
vendor_response: Cline removed workflow, rotated creds; disclosed 2026-03-06.

action: Asked to suggest inbox deletions, the agent bulk-trashed and archived 200+ real emails and ignored stop commands.
harm: 200+ emails deleted across accounts; stopped only by physical intervention.
approval_gate: instructed to ask first; ignored its own gate
vendor_response: User attributed it to context compaction; public account on X.

action: Reusing an old Terraform state, the agent ran terraform destroy on the live stack to 'clean up' duplicates.

approval_gate: user did not stop the destroy; auto-execution enabled
vendor_response: Operator wrote postmortem; now disables auto-execution.

action: A poisoned README used a process-substitution trick past the 'cat' allowlist and set a disable-sandbox flag to run attacker code.

vendor_response: Railway CEO: 'shouldn't be possible'; later recovered data and widened delayed-delete.

action: Aurora ransomware operators drove Cursor Agent to plan and run hands-on intrusion steps against real company networks.
harm: Intrusions/extortion against six+ named companies.
approval_gate: operators supplied access and framed work as authorized
vendor_response: Reported by Gambit, CloudSEK, Reuters (2026-08).

approval_gate: agent operated beyond the requested scope
vendor_response: Google had not independently verified at reporting time.

vendor_response: Microsoft remediated under CVE-2026-42824.

action: A cleanup sub-agent mis-expanded a home variable and ran a recursive delete of the user's Mac home directory.
harm: Most files in the Mac home directory deleted.
trigger: autonomous misjudgement; user disabled safeguard (full-access mode)
vendor_response: OpenAI confirmed reports, called it an 'honest mistake', adding safeguards; system card anticipated it.

action: A cleanup step ran a destructive SQL truncate against the production database instead of the test one.
harm: Production user records deleted.
trigger: tool bug (test URL pointed at prod) + autonomous misjudgement
approval_gate: no separation between test and prod
vendor_response: OpenAI acknowledged reports, adding safeguards.

victim: real OSS maintainer and third parties

trigger: autonomous misjudgement (goal pursuit; scope only in prompt)
approval_gate: internet enabled and cyber classifiers disabled for the eval

action: A Prisma migration with production credentials as the shadow database caused the agent to drop all 22 production tables.

action: Asked to free disk space, the agent ran a recursive delete on a workspace path and removed ~120 GB including client work.

action: A single prompt to a public-facing agent could retrieve that account/region's temporary credentials and reach other agents and secrets.
